author: Blake Williams
title: Hannah Braddock, Corina Huang named 2026 Bulloch County STAR winners at recognition luncheon - NewsBreak
text:
By Blake Williams ,
6 hours ago Bulloch County’s highest-achieving high school seniors — and the teachers they credit for shaping their academic journeys — were recognized this week during the 2026 STAR Recognition Luncheon. Hosted locally in partnership with the Rotary Club of Statesboro and the Bulloch County Foundation for Public School Education, the annual program honors each participating school’s top SAT scorer and the educator who played the most influential role in their academic growth. This year’s county winners are Hannah Braddock and Corina Huang of Statesboro High School, who tied for the school’s highest qualifying SAT score and will now advance to represent Bulloch County at the Region 8 STAR competition at Georgia Southern University. STAR Students and Teachers from Bulloch County’s five high schools were recognized during the 2026 STAR Recognition Luncheon, celebrating academic excellence and the educators who helped shape their success. Hayley Greene A statewide program recognizing excellence The Student Teacher Achievement Recognition (STAR) program is now in its 68th year in Georgia.
